The Black metal atgeir is the third polearm.

Contents

  • 1 Combat style
  • 2 Upgrade information
  • 3 Notes
  • 4 Gallery

Combat style[]

  • Primary attack is a 3-stab combo with long reach and 2x damage on the last hit.
  • Secondary attack is an AOE swing with a three-meter range that deals normal damage and 6x stagger with no multitarget penalty.

Notes[]

  • The secondary attack is enough to stagger most creatures, which makes it optimal for crowd control.
  • Despite the visual resembling a slash, the secondary attack deals piercing damage.
